messages:
deploybot: Canary deploy for release v3.2.0 -> model-encoder-gnmt. Canary group (5%) showing p95 latency increase: +42% over baseline. Error rate up 1.8%. Autoscaled from 2->6 pods.

sarah: saw the same on dashboard, p99 also spiking. Canary window started ~09:07 UTC. @devon are you oncall?

devon: oncall, joining. I see a steady 40-50ms add on p95 for longer context. No obvious OOMs. Repro locally with small load reproduces tail.

mike: logs show a KV cache serialization error intermittently: `kvcache: failed to write prefix: timeout` — might be causing retries and added latency.

rachel: we have live customers in dedicated capacity hitting higher latencies? Any affected SLAs?

jen: support pinged two enterprise customers from US-East, both reported slowdown in embeddings jobs. They're asking if this is a known regression.

sarah: decision needed: rollback to v3.1.4 or pin traffic to fallback model variant (encoder-gnmt-legacy). Pros/cons?

devon: prefer rollback if quick. Pinning variant requires model convert + config push which will take ~30m. Manual rollback can be done in ~10m and verified.

mike: ops checklist: 1) scale canary to 0, 2) pin service->image v3.1.4, 3) clear kvcache nodes, 4) monitor p95/p99. Will run.

deploybot: Rollout monitor suggests auto-rollback threshold not hit (error>2% needed). Flagging for manual action.

sarah: ok manual rollback. @mike can you execute and call once done? I'll notify sales & support.

mike: running commands now:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:v3.1.4
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference
# flush cache
kubectl -n infra exec kvcache-0 -- redis-cli FLUSHALL
```

mike: rollout completed. pods at v3.1.4, replicas healthy.

devon: verified p95 back to baseline within 6m. p99 trending down. No errors in kvcache logs after flush.

sarah: informing customer-facing teams: @jen please send a short note to the two affected accounts; say we rolled back and are monitoring.

jen: pinged customers, included incident reference #INC-2026. They acknowledged, appreciate the quick fix. :thumbsup:

rachel: product note: will add regression to postmortem and block re-deploy until root cause fixed. Also create canary guardrail to fail on kv cache timeouts.

mike: filing PR with mitigation and a hotfix to kvcache retry/backoff. I'll add detailed runbook steps to the rollout doc.

deploybot: thread closed by sarah — manual rollback executed and validated. Metrics stable for 15m.
